title: Raising a dependency's Node floor requires updating engines fields and the README together
answers: npm install on Node 20 warns about engine incompatibility for @mlflow/core
why do the TypeScript package engines say node 22
which package.json engines must change when the Databricks SDK is bumped
Node version requirement for the MLflow TypeScript SDK
body:
Symptom: Installing @mlflow/core or a TypeScript integration on a previously supported Node version (18/20) gets an engine-incompatible transitive dependency.
Root cause: @databricks/sdk-experimental 0.18.0 declares Node >=22, so the supported floor moved. This PR changed the `engines.node` field in libs/typescript/core/package.json and in each integration package.json (anthropic, claude-code, codex, gemini, openai, openclaw, opencode, qwen-code, vercel), plus the 'requires Node.js' note in libs/typescript/README.md.
Fix pattern: When a dependency bump raises its Node requirement, update every affected package's engines field and the README Node note in the same change.
Constraints: A reviewer flagged that this raises the floor above the previously advertised Node 18/20 support for consumers; the diff does not show that this was resolved, so confirm the intended floor before changing these fields again.
applies: Version bumps of runtime dependencies in libs/typescript packages that change minimum Node support.
says: Installing the TypeScript packages on older runtime environments throws an incompatibility warning.
The documentation says version eighteen works, but the package requires a newer runtime.
Update the documented runtime prerequisites whenever minimum version requirements increase.
Confirm whether raising the minimum supported environment version breaks existing consumers.
Keep runtime compatibility declarations consistent across all client library packages.
search: When bumping runtime dependencies like @databricks/sdk-experimental 0.18.0 that raise the minimum Node floor to >=22, update the engines.node field across libs/typescript/core/package.json and all integration package.json files alongside the 'requires Node.js' note in libs/typescript/README.md. Affected integration package manifests include anthropic, claude-code, codex, gemini, openai, openclaw, opencode, qwen-code, and vercel. Applies to runtime dependency bumps in libs/typescript packages, with the constraint to confirm the intended floor before modifying fields because raising the floor above Node 18/20 for consumers was flagged.
